patch_description: A modular pipeline architecture: (1) a deterministic multi-ring lattice generator places 11 points on concentric symmetric rings inside the equilateral triangle, (2) a constraint-based repair stage projects points back inside the region, (3) a local coordinate-descent polisher nudges points to raise the minimum triangle area while keeping determinism via fixed seed. The layers are decoupled functions with a small config dataclass, improving maintainability and allowing any stage to fail gracefully with fallback to the initial construction.
